 p=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 (BASE/(name+'.running.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'pid':p.pid,'command':command,'source_sha256':sha,'wall_limit_seconds':900,'rss_limit_kbytes':8388608},indent=2)+'\n')
 while p.poll() is None:
  try:
   status=Path('/proc')/str(p.pid)/'status'
   row=next((x for x in status.read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('VmRSS:')),'VmRSS: 0 kB')
   rss=int(row.split()[1]);peak=max(peak,rss)
  except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,StopIteration):pass
  if stopped is None and (time.monotonic()-start>900 or peak>8388608):
   stopped='wall_limit' if time.monotonic()-start>900 else 'rss_limit';p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
  if stopped and time.monotonic()-start>915:p.kill()
  time.sleep(.5)
 code=p.wait()
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
result={'status':'PASS' if code==0 and out.exists() else 'INCOMPLETE OR FAILED; see exit and log','module':name,'compiler':COMPILER,'lean_num_threads':'0','source':str(src.relative_to(ROOT)),'source_sha256':sha,'source_unchanged':sha==hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'command':command,'exit_code':code,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'user_seconds':u.ru_utime,'system_seconds':u.ru_stime,'maximum_rss_kbytes':u.ru_maxrss,'polled_peak_rss_kbytes':peak,'resource_cutoff':stopped,'output':str(out),'output_exists':out.exists(),'log':(BASE/(name+'.log')).read_text()}
(BASE/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['status','module','exit_code','wall_seconds','user_seconds','system_seconds','maximum_rss_kbytes','resource_cutoff']},indent=2),flush=True)
sys.exit(code if code>=0 else 128-code)

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitesPerm252
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstancePerm252
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.BootstrapFramePerm252
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Program
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFTheory
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SitesAuditPerm252
open RegisterPath RegisterPathClean RuntimePerm252 RuntimeInstancePerm252
open Permutation252Frame
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.covered_of_allSites
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.related_active
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.clean_suffix
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.source_from_walk
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.related_step
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.stopped_terminal
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.related_halt
#print axioms RuntimeInstancePerm252.partialRun_eq_registerRun

theorem allSitesCaller (p : Program) (t : RMBisim.Tree)
    (ht : RMBisim.ptree p = t) (hs : SiteCoverage.allSites SitePerm252.checkSite [] t = true)
    (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 252)
    (hc : Clean p logical.path)
    (gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat)
    (hf : DispatchFrame SitePerm252.dispatch binary logical gap spares) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p logical ↔ BinaryHalts machinePerm252 binary :=
  allSites_halts_iff_binary p t ht hs logical binary ⟨hc, gap, spares, hf⟩

theorem zeroBootRelated (p : Program) :
    Related p zeroRoot (machinePerm252.run 82552) := by
  refine ⟨RegisterPathClean.clean_nil p, 40, BootPerm252.bootSparesPerm252, ?_⟩
  simpa only [SitePerm252.dispatch, BootstrapFramePerm252.dispatchPerm252] using
    BootstrapFramePerm252.boot_dispatch_frame

theorem zeroBootCaller (p : Program) (hc : Covered p) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p zeroRoot ↔ BinaryHalts machinePerm252 (machinePerm252.run 82552) :=
  register_halts_iff_binary p hc zeroRoot _ (zeroBootRelated p)

theorem blank_prefix (M : Machine n) (N : Nat) :
    BinaryHalts M (M.run N) ↔ ∃ t, (M.run t).state = none := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨N + t, by simpa only [Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom] using ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    have he : M.run (N + t) = M.run (t + N) := by rw [Nat.add_comm N t]
    have hh := M.runFrom_of_halted (M.run t) ht N
    rw [Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom, Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom, hh] at he
    rw [he]
    exact ht

theorem zeroBlankCaller (p : Program) (hc : Covered p) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p zeroRoot ↔ ∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none :=
  (zeroBootCaller p hc).trans (blank_prefix machinePerm252 82552)

#print axioms allSitesCaller
#print axioms zeroBootRelated
#print axioms zeroBootCaller
#print axioms blank_prefix
#print axioms zeroBlankCaller
theorem actual_numeric_endpoint :
    (∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none) ↔ Code254.C254 Code254.F :=
  (zeroBlankCaller Prog254.program
    (covered_of_allSites Prog254.program ActualTree254.tree ActualTree254.tree_eq
      SitesPerm252.all_sites)).symm.trans
      Permutation252Program.literal_zero_halts_iff_c254

theorem actual_native_endpoint :
    (∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none) ↔
      BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot :=
  actual_numeric_endpoint.trans NativeTheory254.c254_refutation_iff

theorem actual_zf_endpoint :
    (∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none) ↔ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot :=
  actual_numeric_endpoint.trans WFTheory.c254_refutation_iff_zf

example : Covered Prog254.program :=
  covered_of_allSites Prog254.program ActualTree254.tree ActualTree254.tree_eq
    SitesPerm252.all_sites
example (P : List Bool) (e : Edge) (d : Nat)
    (hw : walk Prog254.program (Prog254.program.nnodes + 1) Prog254.program.root P 0 = some (e, d)) :
    SitePerm252.checkSite (consume P d) e = true :=
  SitesPerm252.actual_walk_checked P e d hw
example (h : Code254.C254 Code254.F) : ∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none :=
  actual_numeric_endpoint.mpr h
example (h : ∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none) : Code254.C254 Code254.F :=
  actual_numeric_endpoint.mp h
example : (¬ ∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none) ↔ (¬ Code254.C254 Code254.F) :=
  not_congr actual_numeric_endpoint
example : SitePerm252.checkSite (List.replicate 41 false) .halt = false := by decide +kernel
example : SitePerm252.checkSite [] (.inc 9) = false := by decide +kernel
